plan.goal: Close the deterministic wire, transport, command-outbox and dispatcher prerequisites required by Session.
acceptance: Append Requested=8 with exact compatibility goldens and no other wire changes.
Add the exact stepped-transport barrier while preserving every MemoryTransport lifecycle and ownership invariant.
Implement the unified EnqueueResult and bounded fixed-ring CommandOutbox with explicit PacketLease ownership and exact retry/ack semantics.
Extend retained command invokers with internal AOT-safe encoding and configuration probes without changing replication invokers.
Make dispatcher construction reject uninitialized or incompletely registered command worlds before runtime activity.
Move the shared pool-test gate without editing replication tests and prove warmed outbox operations allocate zero managed bytes.
Preserve integrated PacketLease and replication documentation and pass the full package suite.
